reason: An independent pre-result environment smoke found that the host OpenBLAS default attempted 64 worker threads and could fail under concurrent load. This addendum freezes single-thread numerical-library execution before NumPy, Torch, or Transformers import. All scientific selection and scoring definitions from the original amendment and first addendum are unchanged.

numerical_thread_environment.application_time: Direct os.environ assignment in selector module before importing NumPy, Torch, Transformers, or Pillow.
numerical_thread_environment.runtime_gate: The formal selector reads all four environment variables and fails unless the observed mapping exactly equals this mapping.
numerical_thread_environment.provenance: The exact observed mapping is recorded in selection_preflight.json and transitively locked by selection.lock.json. The launcher also supplies the same four variables explicitly.

unchanged: all frozen prompts and candidate eligibility rules
CLIP model, revision, processor, aggregation, and global top-1 tie break
materialization, repair-zero, no-rank-fallback, double-scoring, and interpretation rules
